ext_desc.message: Turn any web page into an EPUB; send to your Kindle or download. Image+text or text-only via a built-in free backend or your own email. Works on Edge mobile.

cfg_title.message: Auto-send to Kindle (with built-in free backend)

ph_smtpPass.message: Get the auth code in your email settings

tip_text.message:
EPUB is generated locally; clicking “Send to Kindle” uses a backend to email the EPUB as an attachment to Amazon (a free shared backend is pre-filled; you can also use your own backend).
First time: add your from-email to Amazon “Approved senders”; QQ/163 etc. need SMTP enabled with an auth code (not your login password).
The auth code is stored only in this extension’s local config.

mail_body.message: The EPUB is downloaded to this device. Please attach it to this email and send it to your Kindle push address.

err_no_content.message: No article found on this page (login wall or lazy-loaded page? reload and retry).

done_img_download.message: EPUB (with $1 images) downloaded. Check your downloads.

done_text_download.message: Text-only EPUB downloaded. Check your downloads.

done_share.message: Share/email picker opened. Choose an email app.

done_share_fallback.message: EPUB downloaded and a mail draft opened. Attach it and send to your Kindle.

tip_mobile_cfg.message: First set the backend URL, from-email, auth code and Kindle email in the desktop popup, then use it on mobile.

prog_too_large.message: Images too large; switching to text-only automatically…

done_too_large.message: Images too large; sent as text-only. Check your from-email for Amazon’s confirmation email to finish delivery.

done_sent.message: Sent to $1. Check your from-email for Amazon’s confirmation email (first time or new sender must confirm).

err_no_backend.message: Enter a backend URL (a free default is pre-filled; clear it to use the default)

err_missing_fields.message: Fill all fields: from-email, auth code, Kindle email

err_comm.message: Cannot talk to the page: $1 (reload the page or reload this extension, then retry)

err_timeout.message: Timed out: page too large or image fetching stalled. Reload the page and retry, or use text-only download.
